basic_details.job_title: Kannur University Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Research Assistant and Field Researcher Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kannur University Research Assistant and Field Researcher Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by Kannur University on its official website for the recruitment of 4 Research Assistant and Field Researcher posts. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for candidates with a postgraduate degree in any Social Science discipline seeking contractual research positions.

qualification.details: Research Assistant: Postgraduate degree in any Social Science discipline. Field Researcher: Postgraduate degree in any Social Science discipline.

salary_details.pay_scale: ₹35,000 per month (Research Assistant), ₹12,000 per month (Field Researcher)

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Kannur University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Kannur University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kannur University recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Assistant and Field Researcher positions at Kannur University is 04 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in any Social Science discipline to be eligible for both the Research Assistant and Field Researcher roles.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced by Kannur University for the Research Assistant and Field Researcher positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process involves sending your complete bio-data and required documents via email to the designated address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for Kannur University recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for a Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of ₹35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for a Field Researcher?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Researcher post will receive a consolidated salary of ₹12,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial shortlisting of applications based on CVs, followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for these positions is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
